lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What are the common early physical symptoms of carbon monoxide poisoning in vehicle occupants?

options.text: Extreme hunger, rapid hair growth, and heightened hearing perception
Headache, dizziness, fatigue, nausea, blurred vision, and sudden drowsiness
Immediate muscle cramps in the feet and severe loss of dental sensation
Intense itching on the palms of the hands and ringing in the ear canals
